chapter: Kid Ory, Hampton, Ellington and Ben Webster
title: Eddie Gomez plays only high
summary: Mingus likes Gomez but wishes he would use the whole bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Oh, yeah, I've heard of him. Is there anybody you especially like among the newer players?
But I wish he'd come downstairs sometimes.
He plays a tune, and he's very fast. But I can't see why he doesn't use the full -- uses the bass, top and bottom. If he'd do that, he'd cut everybody. Right now, he's just playing high.
Yeah. Has he ever explained why?
I don't think he knows any better.
I didn't ask him. It's like a kid playing with blocks. You discover they have blocks at the
bottom and he gets to the top and he puts one block at the top.
And he says, Mama, look, here's a block at the top. He's playing with it.
